techniques.name: Straight-Eighth Heartland Strumming & Steady Rhythm Drive
techniques.description: Locking into an immovable straight-eighth rhythm strum with tight right-hand palm muting on the verses before opening into soaring stadium chords on the chorus.

notes: Verse palm muting on root notes
Chorus open chord downstrokes with accent on beats 2 and 4
sequence: Strum C in steady eighth notes with gentle palm muting
Transition to F and G with firm rhythmic consistency
Open up right-hand strumming into the soaring chorus (F → C → G → Am)
Maintain absolute metronomic timing at 132 BPM
tips: Written by Journey keyboardist Jonathan Cain specifically for Jimmy Barnes
The rhythm guitar must be as steady as a diesel engine—no rushing or dragging
Use a Stratocaster bridge pickup or Les Paul into a cranked Marshall JCM800 for authentic Australian arena crunch

techniques.name: Dave Amato Arena Melodic Lead Phrasing & Wide Vocal Vibrato
techniques.description: Emulating the expressive American arena-rock lead style recorded by guitarist Dave Amato, featuring soaring C major pentatonic target notes, full-step bends on the B string, and wide throat-like vibrato.

notes: Box 1 and Box 2 C major pentatonic positions (frets 7-12)
Whole-step bend on fret 10 B string (A up to B) resolving straight to high C (8th fret E string)
Wide, singing vibrato matching Barnesy's vocal phrasing
Overdriven tube saturation with long sustain
sequence: Establish melodic anchor on the 8th and 10th frets of strings 1 and 2
Bend fret 10 B string up a full tone to the major 7th / octave root
Release smoothly into sweet 3rd intervals across the G and B strings
Lock into the rhythm section's downbeat hits during transitional phrases
tips: Dave Amato (later of REO Speedwagon) laid down the soaring session leads in Los Angeles under producer Bob Clearmountain
Support the 10th fret ring-finger bend with your index and middle fingers on frets 8 and 9
Add an overdrive pedal like a Boss SD-1 or Tube Screamer into the front of the Marshall to push creamy upper harmonics

sections.name: Intro Synth Hook & Driving Entry
sections.description: The song opens with Jonathan Cain's iconic synthesizer ostinato before the full band explodes into a driving straight-eighth groove.
notes: Chugged straight-eighth rhythm locked with the bass drum
Accented downstrokes hitting the 1 of each bar

sections.name: Verse 1 Heartfelt Narrative Chug
sections.description: The honest, driving rhythm guitar bed supporting Jimmy Barnes's legendary vocal storytelling of Australian blue-collar life.
notes: Steady straight-eighth rhythm strumming with subtle heel damping
Keep the pick stroke depth shallow to prevent fret buzz
Clean transitions between root notes and chords

sections.name: Pre-Chorus Dynamic Lift
sections.description: Building the tension under 'He's got a simple life, and a heart of gold...', releasing the palm muting into open ring.
notes: Gradually lift palm muting across the four bars
Accentuate the emotional vi chord (Am)
Build pick velocity toward the climactic downbeat of the chorus

sections.name: Chorus Arena Anthem
sections.description: The monumental Australian rock chorus 'He's a working class man' featuring massive open voicings and driving quarter-note accents.
sections.progression: F - C - G - Am - F - C - G
notes: Open, resonant chord downstrokes with maximum projection
Accent the emotional turn to Am
Lock tight with the driving drum kick and snare on 2 and 4

sections.name: Soaring Arena Lead Guitar Solo
sections.technique: Major Pentatonic Vocal Bends & Wide Vibrato
sections.description: Dave Amato's soaring arena rock guitar solo in 8th-position C major pentatonic with sweet vocal bends and sustained crying notes.
sections.progression: F - C - G - Am - F - C - G
notes: Reinforced 3-finger bend on fret 10 B string up to pitch
Singing vibrato with warm tube overdrive and studio plate reverb
Smooth diatonic descent landing squarely on the tonic C note

sections.name: Outro Anthem & Driving Climax
sections.technique: Outro Lead Fills & Dynamic Power Chords
sections.description: The emotional climax of the song where the chorus repeats endlessly behind Barnes's iconic raw screams and screaming lead fills.
notes: Mix full open power chords with high melodic lead fills
Maintain fierce 132 BPM momentum all the way to the final fade
Keep pick hand relaxed despite the extreme high energy

beginner.title: The Four Core Chords
steps: Master the four fundamental open chords: C, F, G, and Am
Practice steady down-up eighth-note strumming at 100 BPM
Transition cleanly between F and G without pausing

intermediate.title: Full-Speed Rhythm (132 BPM)
steps: Lock into the driving 132 BPM tempo with palm-muted verse control
Strum the full chorus progression with dynamic arena power
Play along seamlessly with the studio recording

advanced.title: Arena Lead Solos & Fills
steps: Learn the 8th-position C major pentatonic solo note-for-note
Master accurate full-step bends and singing vibrato
Deliver the authentic Australian anthem tone and feel

commonMistakes: Rushing the tempo during the chorus excitement
Fumbling the transition from F barre chord to C major
Under-bending on the 10th fret B string in the guitar solo
